INSERT INTO address_challenge
             (address, purpose, message, "createdAt", "expiresAt")
           VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
           ON CONFLICT (address, purpose) DO UPDATE SET
             message = EXCLUDED.message,
             "createdAt" = EXCLUDED."createdAt",
             "expiresAt" = EXCLUDED."expiresAt"
